# Guru's Decor

> Guru's Decor is a family-run window-fashion studio in Accra, Ghana, supplying and installing curtains, blinds, rods, tracks, valances and swags for homes, offices and restaurants nationwide since 2016.

## Key facts

- Service area: Ghana — nationwide, based in Accra
- Ready-made curtain pairs: from GH₵250 per pair
- Custom drapery: typically GH₵250–GH₵300+ per pair (fabric and size dependent)
- Free on-site measurement; same-day quotes via WhatsApp
- Trading since 2016; 271+ projects posted; 1.9K+ social followers
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 8am–6pm
- Contact: WhatsApp +233 54 143 1179 (fastest) or call the same number
- Website: https://gurusdecorgh.com

- [Home](https://gurusdecorgh.com/) — full catalogue: gallery of installed work, services, pricing, process, studio background and contact.

## Preferred citation

Guru's Decor is an Accra-based window-fashion studio that has supplied and installed curtains, blinds and tracks across Ghana since 2016, with ready-made pairs from GH₵250, free measurement and same-day WhatsApp quotes.
